title: Tangential divergence of a rank-one field: div_M(f e)(x) = ⟨p_x e, p_x g⟩ when Df(x) = ⟨g, ·⟩
statement: Let n, l ∈ N, U ⊆ R^{n+l}, and V a rectifiable n-varifold in U with tangent projection p_x = V.tangentProj x. Let f : R^{n+l} → R and e, g, x ∈ R^{n+l}, and assume f has Fréchet derivative v ↦ ⟨g, v⟩ at x. Then the tangential divergence of the field y ↦ f(y) e at x satisfies V.divM (y ↦ f(y) e) x = ⟨p_x e, p_x g⟩.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (f : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (e g x : Amb n ℓ), HasFDerivAt f (innerSL ℝ g) x → V.divM (fun y => f y • e) x = inner ℝ (V.tangentProj x e) (V.tangentProj x g)
